event: Her last stretch of counting settles as the chant begins.
Window: Path of Basic Numeracy - Tier 2. Mental +1.
Under the chanting, she turns to her Status and dwells on the Path of Soulstealing.
Window: Soulstealing (mutated) - steps only from shreds of demon-ridden souls dying nearby.
Window: Soulstealing - Tier 1 at 10 steps: Aether Core rises one grade.
She dwells next on the Path of the Completionist.
Window: Completionist - one step for each Path she completes.
Window: Completionist - Tier 1 at 1 step: 2 Unallocated Stats.
She grasps it: a Path is nothing to use; dwelling on one only shows what earns it.
The chant goes on outside, many voices close around her, in words she doesn't know.
